content: Brown noise: fill an AudioBuffer via leaky integrator over white noise (out = (last + 0.02*white)/1.02, scaled ~3.5x), loop with AudioBufferSourceNode.loop=true; buffers >=2s avoid audible loop artifacts. Shape wind with BiquadFilter lowpass + LFO/setTargetAtTime gain gusts. For top-down 2D-ish spatialization StereoPannerNode + distance-scaled GainNode is the standard lightweight choice; full PannerNode HRTF is overkill and costs more CPU. StereoPannerNode is Baseline, universal browser support. Source nodes are one-shot: create per play.
